The benchmark deliverable has been written directly to [index.html](file:///private/tmp/pcd-sbx-gemini-3.8-flash-oiappqq5/work/index.html).

### Summary of Implementation

- **Architecture & Single-File Delivery:**
  - Self-contained [index.html](file:///private/tmp/pcd-sbx-gemini-3.8-flash-oiappqq5/work/index.html) with zero auxiliary files.
  - Pin-loads Three.js `r128` UMD via CDN with `renderer.outputEncoding = THREE.sRGBEncoding;`.
  - Zero CORS dependencies, external textures, models, or network fetches.

- **Deterministic Simulation Engine (Seed `42`):**
  - Seeded `Mulberry32` PRNG initialized strictly with seed `42` (`Math.random()` completely omitted).
  - Closed-form analytical ballistic trajectories with air drag ($K_D$) and gravity ($g$) evaluated via `renderAt(simTime)` on GPU vertex shaders and analytical uniforms for frame-exact, reversible scrubbing across any display refresh rate (60Hz–240Hz).

- **High-Speed Physics & Visual Phases ($0.000\text{s} - 8.000\text{s}$):**
  1. **Approach ($0.000\text{s} - 1.000\text{s}$):** Copper/brass spitzer bullet travels from offscreen right ($+X \to -X$) with Mach shockwave cone toward primed balloon.
  2. **Elastic Contact & Burst ($1.000\text{s} - 1.600\text{s}$):** Contact at $1.000\text{s}$, elastic skin indentation ($1.000\text{s} - 1.080\text{s}$), followed by high-speed skin tear ($1.080\text{s} - 1.600\text{s}$) retracting towards the tether knot and base rim with recoil spring vibration.
  3. **Inertial Stasis ($1.600\text{s} - 2.400\text{s}$):** Free-standing water teardrop retains balloon silhouette in mid-air with surface capillary wavelets while bullet penetrates water interior.
  4. **Cavitation Tunnel & Wake ($2.400\text{s} - 3.800\text{s}$):** Expanding low-pressure vapor tunnel behind projectile core with backwards cavitation blowout jet venting $450$ droplets out of the entry hole.
  5. **Exit Puncture & Forward Cone ($3.800\text{s} - 5.000\text{s}$):** Bullet exits left boundary at $3.800\text{s}$, unleashing an $850$-particle supersonic forward spray cone of atomized mist and micro-droplets.
  6. **Fluid Disintegration & Splashdown ($5.000\text{s} - 8.000\text{s}$):** Rayleigh-Taylor and Plateau-Rayleigh breakup into $2,700$ bulk droplets and $1,000$ mist particles cascading under gravity, while the retracted latex remnant quivers at the top tether.

- **Lighting & Aesthetics:**
  - Three-point studio lighting with key light, soft fill, and dual high-intensity rim lights (cool cyan/white and magenta) to illuminate droplet meniscus refraction and Fresnel edge boundaries.
  - Procedural in-memory offscreen canvas textures for water droplets (with specular key and rim highlights) and atomized mist.

- **Canonical UI & 5-State Playback Machine:**
  - Verbatim DOM markup and CSS rules for `#dock` and `#countdown`.
  - Full adherence to state transitions: 3-second wall-clock `COUNTDOWN` (3 $\to$ 2 $\to$ 1), clamped `PLAYING`, instant `PAUSED`, 1-second silent `REFIRE_HOLD`, and seamless `ENDED` hold.
  - Interactive speed pills (`0.25×`, `0.5×`, `1.0×`, `2.0×`) and millisecond-accurate timeline scrubber.
